question: Can crews at Building 7 get to Lincoln High without driving a blocked road?
note: Building 7 is on 3rd Street, the shelter on Oak Avenue; Oak Avenue's only links are Main Street (blocked) and Bridge Street (blocked, conflicted), so every route crosses a blocked road. gold_cypher enumerates the 3rd->Oak paths with their blocked roads (every path has n_blocked >= 1); compare passes if the system's rows surface Road-Main or Road-Bridge. Facts + grounding carry the rest.; orig id hB15; validator added gold_cypher + compare (candidate had none; hard rule requires >=1 gold row)
gold_cypher: MATCH (:Building {id:'Building-7'})-[:ON_ROAD]->(start:Road), (:Facility {id:'Facility-LincolnHS'})-[:ON_ROAD]->(dest:Road) MATCH p = (start)-[:CONNECTS_TO*1..6]-(dest) WITH p, [x IN nodes(p) WHERE x.status = 'blocked' | x.id] AS blocked RETURN [x IN nodes(p) | x.id] AS route, blocked, size(blocked) AS n_blocked, length(p) AS hops ORDER BY n_blocked ASC, hops ASC LIMIT 3

question: E7 to B22 - clear route?
note: Engine 7 has no STAGED_AT/NEAR; its nearest road by position is 3rd Street (114 m). Building 22 is on Oak Avenue, whose only links are Main Street (blocked) and Bridge Street (blocked, conflicted): no clean route. gold_cypher enumerates the paths with their blocked roads; compare passes if the system's rows surface Road-Main or Road-Bridge. Facts + grounding carry the rest.; orig id hB16; validator added gold_cypher + compare (candidate had none; hard rule requires >=1 gold row)
gold_cypher: MATCH (t:Team {id:'Team-Engine7'}), (start:Road) WHERE start.location IS NOT NULL WITH t, start ORDER BY point.distance(t.location, start.location) ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (:Building {id:'Building-22'})-[:ON_ROAD]->(dest:Road) MATCH p = (start)-[:CONNECTS_TO*1..6]-(dest) WITH p, [x IN nodes(p) WHERE x.status = 'blocked' | x.id] AS blocked RETURN [x IN nodes(p) | x.id] AS route, blocked, size(blocked) AS n_blocked, length(p) AS hops ORDER BY n_blocked ASC, hops ASC LIMIT 3
